title: Lad event envelope (v1)
description: DRAFT by osovyk for review; owner TBD. The same envelope for every topic (spec §12). Partition key is always school_id. Event schemas extend it with allOf and pin `type` and `data`.

event_id.description: Unique per event; consumers deduplicate on it (inbox). solver uses uuid5(namespace, "{job_id}:{type}") so a re-sent event keeps its id.

type.description: Event type, e.g. solve.build.requested, solve.started, solve.completed.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the data schema. Additive changes bump MINOR (readers ignore unknown fields); breaking changes bump MAJOR and a reader rejects an unknown MAJOR.

correlation_id.description: Copied from the request that caused the event; ends up in every log line.
